reason: The premise states that "Dentures have a shorter lifespan than DentalImplants" and "DentalImplants enhance oral health compared to Bridges," which contradicts the conclusion that "DentalImplants are costlier than Bridges," as one would expect a more effective and longer-lasting option to be more valuable, not necessarily costlier.
refined_position: Causal Inconsistency - The expectation that a more effective and longer-lasting option (DentalImplants) should be more valuable (costlier) contradicts the conclusion that they are costlier than Bridges.
reflecting_rules: - 7. Q[13, 14](Dentures haveShorterLifespanThan DentalImplants ∧ DentalImplants enhanceOralHealthComparedTo Bridges → DentalImplants areCostlierThan Bridges)
